_note: Verify every step against current platform menus before release (FR-GUIDE-08). Fix the Instagram recovery email against Instagram's official help page.

steps.title: Enable Two-Step Verification
steps.body: Settings → Privacy and Security → Two-Step Verification. Set a cloud password.

steps.title: Review login methods
steps.body: Check QR login use and your Devices list regularly.

steps.title: Unknown devices
steps.body: A device in your Devices list that you do not recognize.

steps.title: Terminate other sessions
steps.body: Settings → Devices → Terminate all other sessions. Then escalate via telegram.org.
